items.title: 3.7 Intermolecular forces (molecules ke beech ki forces) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.7, printed page 67.

blocks.text: Intermolecular forces (molecules ke beech ki forces) bhi chemical bonds ki tarah jorne wali forces mani jati hain. Lekin molecules ke beech attraction (kashish) chemical bonds se bohat kamzor hoti hai. Yeh forces har qism ke atoms aur molecules ke beech hoti hain jab woh ek doosre ke kaafi qareeb hon. Aisi intermolecular forces ko van der Waals forces kehte hain. Yeh molecules ko qareeb lati hain aur gas, liquid aur solid state mein substances ko un ki khas physical properties deti hain.
Yahan in forces ki teen qismein batai gayi hain:

items: Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces, ya London dispersion forces

blocks.text: In forces ki tafseel 'states and phases of matter' wale chapter mein aaye gi.

blocks.prompt: HCl molecules ke beech teen mein se kaun si intermolecular force hogi, aur argon jaisi noble gas ke atoms ke beech kaun si?
blocks.explanation: HCl molecules permanent dipoles hain, is liye un ke beech permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces hain (London forces ke saath). Argon atoms ka koi permanent dipole nahi, is liye un ke beech sirf instantaneous dipole-induced dipole (London dispersion) forces hain.

items: Van der Waals (intermolecular) forces molecules ke beech kamzor forces hain jo gases, liquids aur solids ki physical properties decide karti hain: London dispersion, permanent dipole-dipole aur hydrogen bonding.
